newsitem.title: USA: Healthdyne sees profit margins improving.
newsitem.headline: Healthdyne sees profit margins improving.

text.p: Medical device maker Healthdyne Technologies Inc, reporting higher first quarter operating results, said Tuesday it expects gross profit margins to improve this year as it brings new products to market.
The success of new products like Quantum, a non-invasive ventilator, helped raise profits in the first quarter, it said.

"The ongoing introduction of proprietary high-technology products with higher gross margins is a key element of our strategic plan as other commodity-based products in our industry continue to experience price and margin pressure," it said.
It also said selling and administrative expenses as a percentage of revenues were likely to decrease even more than they already had.
The company said it plans to introduce in the second quarter a bi-level device as well as a new peak flow meter called AsthmaCheck.
The rest of its new product introductions are on schedule, it added.
